features: Wisenet X 5MP stainless-steel vandal IR dome
Loitering / directional / audio detection, sound classification, defog
release_notes: Ingest 2026-09-08 (Wisenet X 'RS' stainless-steel line gap fill; discontinued). No official DataSheet PDF reachable in Hanwha's PIM and the product page's full spec table is JS-rendered; record built from the official product-details overview. Verified: 5MP (2560x1920), 3.9-9.4mm 2.4x motorized varifocal, IR 50m, 30fps@all-res, H.265/H.264/MJPEG, WDR 120dB, dual microSD up to 512GB, PoE, IP66/NEMA4X/IK10+ (recorded as IK10 since the schema enum tops at IK11; IK10+ noted here), stainless steel housing, digital auto-tracking, bi-directional audio (line in/out, no built-in mic/speaker). Minimum illumination, sensor size, angle of view, operating temperature, dimensions and weight were not machine-readable and are omitted (not fabricated).

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hanwha' (or 'Samsung' on older Blue Iris versions).
